segments.name: Home Health and Hospice Services
segments.description: Provides home health, hospice, home care, and geriatric primary and palliative care services to patients in their homes and other settings.
segments.evidence: We have two reportable segments: (1) home health and hospice services, which includes our home health, hospice, home care, and geriatric primary and palliative care businesses; and (2) senior living services, which includes our assisted living, independent living and memory care services.

segments.name: Senior Living Services
segments.description: Operates assisted living, independent living and memory care communities providing accommodation, meals, housekeeping and daily living assistance to seniors.
segments.evidence: We have two reportable segments: (1) home health and hospice services, which includes our home health, hospice, home care, and geriatric primary and palliative care businesses; and (2) senior living services, which includes our assisted living, independent living and memory care services.

revenueModel.text: Medicare, Medicaid, managed care organizations, and private patients and residents pay for home health, hospice and senior living services.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive revenue from a diversified blend of payors including Medicare and Medicaid programs, private pay patients and residents, and managed care payors.
